messages:
Maya (sec): urgent — monitoring team flagged active exploitation in the wild of CVE-2026-21001. kms-agent audit logging can include plaintext key material when configured with verbose payloads. we need immediate mitigation and comms.
Priya (sre): ack. where was this seen? customer env or internal?
Maya (sec): first seen in a partner cluster (managed customers). attack pattern: exfil via misconfigured audit endpoint + verbose payloads. exploit looks automated.
Jason (infra): can we toggle audit verbosity centrally? quick idea: set audit.redact_payload=true in /etc/kms-agent/config.d/00-audit.toml and restart.
Diego (platform): rolling that change across Dedicated and Private is nontrivial — some on-prem customers manage that file themselves. need a patch and a safe config default.
Maya (sec): mitigation plan initial: 1) push config change to hosted fleets (redact_payload=true), 2) block outbound egress from kms-agent processes to unknown endpoints via iptables/cloud-firewall, 3) emergency upgrade to kms-agent 2.3.4 (contains payload-sanitizer). also recommend immediate KMS key rotation for any keys accessed in last 72h.
Priya (sre): I'm on hosted rollout. will prepare canary and quick rollback. timeline estimate: canary in 10min, full in 90min if no regressions.
alex-oncall: putting oncall pager on standby. will watch error spikes.
deploy-bot: scheduled rolling config update for cluster-redwood-hosted-1 at 2026-02-11T18:22:00Z, canary->10%->50%->100%.
Jason (infra): for private customers we should: a) provide signed patch + instructions, b) provide a prebuilt container with sanitized logging, c) offer an assist window for customers in highest risk buckets. I'll draft the KB.
Elena (legal): flagging that if customer data was exfiltrated we need to follow breach notification timelines for regulated customers. coordinate comms with customer-success.
Maya (sec): agreed. Priya, Jason — add detection rules: search S3/logging buckets for patterns like "\"key_material\":\"[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{40,}\"" and alert. also add IDS signature for unusual POSTs to audit endpoints.
Diego (platform): adding a temporary mutex: kms-agent will now return 403 for unauthenticated audit-forwarding endpoints by default. rolling patch PR: https://git.internal/redwood/kms-agent/pull/478 (WIP).
Priya (sre): can you paste the minimal commands for hosted emergency? will run now.
Maya (sec): minimal hosted mitigation steps:
```
# redact payloads
sudo tee /etc/kms-agent/config.d/00-audit.toml <<'EOF'
[audit]
redact_payload = true
EOF
sudo systemctl restart kms-agent
# block egress (example)
sudo iptables -I OUTPUT -m owner --uid-owner kmsagent -j DROP
```
Run those on canary host first.
Jason (infra): for automation use the operator patch:
```
kubectl -n kube-system patch daemonset kms-agent -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"kms-agent","env":[{"name":"AUDIT_REDACT_PAYLOAD","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'
```
Diego (platform): note: some older versions ignore AUDIT_REDACT_PAYLOAD, that's why upgrade to 2.3.4 required.
Priya (sre): canary completed. no immediate errors. rolling to 10% now.
Maya (sec): meanwhile, Security will open rights-scoped access review for KMS roles used in last 7 days. if there are service accounts with broad access, rotate creds.
alex-oncall: observed +approx 45 failed kms-agent connections to external ip 54.32.11.9 at 18:24 UTC — blocked now.
audit-bot: automated scan: found 12 hosts with audit_level=verbose and old kms-agent (<2.2.0). list: host-12, host-47, host-89.
Maya (sec): Priya/Jason — please prioritize hosts from audit-bot list. Diego — notify high-risk private customers and offer hotfix.
Jason (infra): drafting KB now: https://kb.internal/redwood/kms-audit-leak-mitigation (will include rotation playbook).
Elena (legal): also prepare template for customer notification. security/comms must sign off before send.
Diego (platform): putting a temporary UI banner in Console for customers in affected regions advising to follow patch steps and rotate keys.
Priya (sre): full rollout complete at 18:50 UTC. monitoring for errors.
Maya (sec): great. action items recap: 1) hosted rollout (Priya) — done, 2) private hotfix + assist (Jason/Diego) — in progress, 3) detection/IDS rules (Jason) — in progress, 4) key rotations for exposed keys (Security + CS) — start now, 5) comms & legal (Elena + Product) — draft and review. owners assigned in incident ticket.
alex-oncall: reopening pager if error rate >5% increase.
Maya (sec): we'll follow up with a post-incident review 48h after stabilization. if anyone finds evidence of confirmed exfiltration, DM me immediately. :lock:
Diego (platform): PR merged, release notes prepared. private customers with managed support will get automated patch.
Jason (infra): KB link updated with rotation checklist and CLI commands for bulk rotatation.
Elena (legal): confirmed notification template ready for review.
Maya (sec): closing thread for now — moving to incident channel for live coordination: <#incidents/1819002000>
Priya (sre): thanks all, great response. :thumbsup:
